thread:
lina: thinking about adding lightweight metadata tags to toolcall responses so routing/quota/console can surface why an invocation fell back. quick sketch below.

lina: ```
X-Inv-Meta: route=canary;variant=v2;fallback=soft_validate;validate_score=0.81;sample_id=abc123hash
```

dan: what's the cardinality here? worried about metric explosion if we start tagging everything.

lina: aiming for a small fixed set: route, variant, fallback, validate_score_bucket, sample_id_hash. validate_score_bucket = {high,mid,low}. that keeps metric dimensions bounded.

ashley: console note: we can't show raw codes. map fallback -> human label (e.g. soft_validate -> "Schema soft-fallback"). show badge in trace list and offer quick link to the runbook. :eyes:

sree: billing question: how do we ensure quota / billing attribution when a fallback routes to a cheaper model? need deterministic mapping so usage isn't double-counted.

lina: proposal: include model_variant and route_id in the invoke event that's used by billing pipeline. metric ingestion stores tags at scalar level (counts, token-agg) 100%, while full-tagged payloads are sampled (1% by default, dynamic on spikes). tagging won't change token accounting, just attribution.

dan: fine but make sampling adaptive. rule: if fallback_rate > 0.5% over 5m window, bump full-tag sampling to 10% for 15m. otherwise 0.5%. keeps storage sane and captures anomalies. pseudo-rule: ```if (fallback_rate > 0.005) then sampling=0.1 else sampling=0.005```

ashley: UX mock idea: in the per-route dashboard show a stacked bar: primary success / soft-fallback / hard-fallback. hover shows most common fallback reasons and a link to "why my call fell back" modal. include copy for modal: "Soft validate: output didn't match schema so we returned a degraded structured response."

deploy-bot: rollout: parsing for X-Inv-Meta header enabled in canary (eng-platform nodes). rollout started at 7209876590. watch fallback-rate and sampling logs.

sree: integration test: curl example to simulate a soft-validate fallback:
```bash
curl -H "X-Inv-Meta: route=canary;variant=v2" -d '{"input":"trigger invalid shape"}' https://invoke.internal/exec
```

dan: security note: do not put prompt text or user identifiers in the meta. only hashed ids (sample_id_hash) and enums. scrub at the ingress.

lina: agreed. i'll open the PR with header parsing, telemetry flags, and a small console ticket for the badge + modal. assigning ashley for UX copy and sree for billing verification. cc @dan for sampling rules. :+1:
